etymologies.heading: Etymology 1
paragraphs: From Middle English destitute, destitut, from Latin dēstitūtus.
senses: (followed by the preposition "of") Lacking something; devoid.
Lacking money, poor, impoverished; especially, extremely so.

etymologies.heading: Etymology 2
paragraphs: From Middle English destituten, from the adjective (see above).
senses: (transitive) To impoverish; to strip of wealth, resources, etc.
